title: День рождения Кати и страховка Сени  (Katya's Birthday and Senya's Insurance)

scenes.title: Последний день страховки  (The Last Day of Insurance)
scenes.summary: On the final day of his four-year injury insurance policy, Senya asks Chef Barinov to break his finger so he can collect sixty thousand rubles.

scenes.title: Особый случай  (A Special Occasion)
scenes.summary: Eleonora announces a family dinner for Katya's twenty-sixth birthday, and Nagiyev teases Chef Barinov for forgetting his daughter's birthday.

scenes.title: Зеркало для мотоцикла  (The Motorcycle Mirror)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov learns the cooks are pooling money for Katya's gift and confiscates the motorcycle mirror Denis bought so he can give it to Katya himself.

scenes.title: Нежданная гостья Нагиева  (Nagiyev's Unexpected Guest)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev panics when a glamorous secret flame shows up at the hotel looking for him while Eleonora is just down the hall.

scenes.title: Сделка лучших друзей  (Best Friends' Deal)
scenes.summary: After Chef Barinov takes his mirror, Denis asks Senya what to give Katya, and Fedya demands thirty thousand rubles to break Senya's finger.

scenes.title: В гостях у родителей Насти  (Visiting Nastya's Parents)
scenes.summary: Kostya and Nastya arrive at her parents' country house for a barbecue, where Kostya is shocked to find his estranged father waiting for them.

scenes.title: Подарки для именинницы  (Gifts for the Birthday Girl)
scenes.summary: The kitchen staff and Katya's parents gather to wish her a happy birthday, and Chef Barinov gives her the motorcycle mirror he took from Denis.

scenes.title: Новый мотоцикл от Нагиева  (A New Motorcycle from Nagiyev)
scenes.summary: Dmitry Nagiyev completely upstages Chef Barinov's mirror by wheeling a brand-new motorcycle into the restaurant as his birthday gift for Katya.

scenes.title: Инвестиция в новый фильм  (Investment in a New Film)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev explains to his secret lover that the motorcycle for Katya is an investment to get Eleonora to fund a movie about his life.

scenes.title: Шашлык на даче  (Barbecue at the Dacha)
scenes.summary: At the country house, even vegetarian Nastya eats Timofey Ilyich's barbecue for the sake of family peace, while Kostya stubbornly refuses.

scenes.title: Тихий час на складе  (Quiet Hour in the Storage Room)
scenes.summary: In the storage room, Senya bargains with Chef Barinov to break his finger, but they are interrupted before the chef can strike.

scenes.title: Подозрения Михаила  (Mikhail's Suspicions)
scenes.summary: At the bar, Mikhail convinces Chef Barinov that Nagiyev only buys expensive vehicles for women he is trying to seduce.

scenes.title: Звонок из номера 313  (The Call from Room 313)
scenes.summary: While Katya chats with a friend on the phone, Nagiyev's mistress calls him from room 313 and demands he come upstairs immediately.

scenes.title: Секрет за дверью  (The Secret Behind the Door)
scenes.summary: Overhearing Nagiyev say room 313 and learning Katya went to room 313, Chef Barinov believes Nagiyev is seducing Katya and alerts Eleonora.

scenes.title: Колье от Никиты  (The Necklace from Nikita)
scenes.summary: In his hotel suite, Nikita presents Katya with a diamond necklace even pricier than her motorcycle, but ruins the moment by assuming she will stay the night.

scenes.title: Охота на Нагиева  (Hunting Down Nagiyev)
scenes.summary: Katya dumps a bucket of ice water on Nikita and leaves, while next door Chef Barinov barges into Nagiyev's room believing Katya is in the shower.

scenes.title: Разоблачение в номере  (Exposure in the Room)
scenes.summary: While Chef Barinov demands to know where Katya is, Nagiyev's mistress steps out of the bathroom right in front of Eleonora.

scenes.title: Пожар и песня Дениса  (The Fire and Denis's Song)
scenes.summary: While a fire breaks out at the country house, the clock strikes midnight without Senya breaking his finger, and Denis admits he wrote a song for Katya.

scenes.title: Спасение на даче и развод  (Rescue at the Dacha and Divorce)
scenes.summary: Denis sings his heartfelt song to Katya, Timofey Ilyich rescues baby Styopa from the burning dacha, and Eleonora tells Nagiyev she wants a divorce.

scenes.title: Запоздавший перелом  (The Late Fracture)
scenes.summary: After midnight, Senya accidentally breaks his finger for real, only for the insurance agent to inform him that his policy expired at midnight.
